title: Ramsey’s Theorem for Pairs in Pincus’s Model XI
summary: Howard and Rubin record Pincus’s ordered colored permutation model as N48, but do not determine whether Ramsey’s theorem for pairs holds there. We prove that N48 |= RT for pairs. The proof uses least finite supports and the homogeneity of Pincus’s ordered colored structure: after fixing all but one point of a support, the remaining point generates an infinite orbit whose unordered pairs form a single stabilizer orbit.
